title: PeerHub R1 production-call map baseline
scope_boundary: Characterization only. This artifact records existing production paths, including bypasses and asserted actors; it does not implement D-CTX, P4b authorization convergence, or the typed call transport.

measurement.method: Monkeypatch argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args while calling peerhub.cli:main, capture the constructed root parser, recursively traverse each actual _SubParsersAction choice, and select parsers with no child subparser.

classifications.READ_ONLY: Local state/config read with no intended write.
classifications.EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION: May inspect or execute a bounded external readiness/version probe but does not intentionally mutate PeerHub state.
classifications.MUTATING: Writes PeerHub durable state or managed config.
classifications.MUTATING_EXTERNAL: Writes PeerHub state and/or a requested output while also invoking a vendor process or material external filesystem effect.
classifications.CONDITIONAL_MUTATION: The command path is read-only for some argument shapes and mutating for others.
classifications.CONDITIONAL_MUTATION_EXTERNAL: The command path is read-only for some argument shapes and may both probe externally and persist results for others.

known_gaps: ApplicationAPI is not the common entrance for these CLI mutators; DIRECT_CLI_BYPASS is an observed R1 baseline label, not a remediation claim.
Several leaf paths have no execution-level integration test that reaches peerhub.cli:main; they are marked TEST NEEDED rather than being credited with service-only or parser-only coverage.

Output/exit descriptions characterize stable branch behavior and caught-error mappings in peerhub/cli.py. They do not claim that every uncaught exception string or traceback is a supported wire contract.
Workspace resolution still reflects the pre-R2 repeated Path.resolve/_detect_workspace_home_id composition.
